text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high rate of TLS handshake failures seen between Cloudflare edge and api.redwood.ai (edge -> origin). Alerts triggered at 23:07 UTC. Initial error class: TLS handshake timeout / 525. Affected regions: EU-West, US-East. Impact: 20% increase in 5xx for inbound API traffic.

Priya: i'm seeing the same in the console — p50 latency up, bursts of 522/524/525. adding @Liam as sec oncall. anyone touching cloud config?

Liam: not me. checking logs + CDN health now. on it.

Alex: noticed Auth provider (auth.internal.redwood) auth requests failing to complete in same window — could be CF -> origin causing upstream timeouts. Datadog ingestion also showing dropped spans from our edge collectors.

Priya: copying checklist: 1) confirm CF status 2) validate origin health 3) isolate region(s) 4) customer mitigation (bypass CF for critical customers) 5) open support ticket with Cloudflare.

Priya: quick check: https://status.cloudflare.com shows a partial outage on some edge POPs (link posted).

Liam: traceroute to problematic edge shows handshake hanging at TLS layer. raw curl result:```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health --resolve "api.redwood.ai:443:198.51.100.12"
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connection timed out after 30001 ms
* Closing connection 0
* TLS handshake timeout
```

Alex: rolling origin bypass for customer-tenants flagged as high-priority. creating short-lived ingress rule to route their traffic direct to origin IPs (bypass CF). will post changes and rollback plan.

ops-bot: Runbook step executed: elevated logging enabled for frontend-proxy in EU-West. Command: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/frontend-proxy EDGE_LOG=debug --record`

Priya: who can open the Cloudflare ticket? need to get edge IDs + sample trace ids. Liam can you collect the edge IPs + sample request IDs?

Liam: grabbing request IDs now. patched a temporary route for /v1/chat to go through alternate POP via our edge-routing policy (policy-id: alt-route-042). Doing canary 5% first.

Liam: snippet of failing request IDs: rId-20230307-az1-0a1b2c, rId-20230307-eu2-5f6g7h. attaching network logs to ticket.

Priya: Nora (CS) — we need a short customer note. Which customers are seeing errors?

Nora (CS): jira-redwood-cs: high-volume customers in EU are reporting increased errors for embeddings and chat. I've put an incident banner in the status page draft and will hold until we confirm scope.

Alex: Datadog shows stack traces pointing to TLS renegotiation failures at edge. Observability vendor (DD) also shows partial ingestion gaps — file a support ticket there too.

Priya: ok, owners: Cloudflare ticket (Liam), Datadog ticket (Alex), CS comms (Nora), mitigation (Priya + Liam).

Liam: opened CF support ticket #12345678, included edge IPs, request IDs, and sample tcpdumps. awaiting response. (link: internal ticket tracker).

Priya: temporary mitigations applied: - Canary alt-route 5% -> 50% for EU-West - Direct origin bypass for 3 highest-traffic tenants - Increased retry/backoff in edge proxy to reduce hammering

ops-bot: Action logged: alter-egress-rule applied to infra-nginx to permit direct origin paths for bypassed tenants.

Alex: Datadog ticket created with case ID DD-9081; they confirm ingestion delays in our EU region and are investigating their collector fleet hitting Cloudflare egress issues.

Priya: customer impact assessment as of 23:35 UTC: approx 14% of API requests across EU-West failing with TLS handshake related 5xx. US-East saw a smaller blip (3-4%). High-priority customers currently routed via bypass — no customer-facing errors for them.

Liam: CF support responded: they're seeing elevated error rates on a subset of POPs tied to a routing flap between two backbone providers. Root cause being worked on, ETA unknown. Suggested mitigation: switch affected traffic to alternate POPs or use direct origin lift for critical traffic.

Priya: rolling to 50% alt-route now. will monitor for error rate delta.

Liam: telemetry after 50% roll: EU-West error rate dropped from 14% -> 6% in 8m. latency p95 still elevated. continuing ramp.

Nora (CS): I'll push a controlled status page update: "We are investigating partial API reachability issues affecting some EU traffic; mitigations in progress. For priority support, contact cs@redwood.ai" — posting in 10m unless you want earlier.

Priya: go ahead. include that we've opened tickets with Cloudflare and Datadog.

Alex: note — auth provider (internal cluster) retries causing burst traffic to our origin; we've added circuit-breaker rules to auth calls to reduce load. config snippet:```
service: auth-proxy
limits:
  concurrent_requests: 30
  retry_policy: exponential
```

Priya: good. low-level note: we should consider keeping bypass for select tenants for the next 2 hours, but plan to retract when CF fixes POPs. track rollback steps in this thread.

Liam: CF says they have a mitigative routing change being propagated; expected partial recovery in 20-30 minutes. will update ticket with our telemetry.

ops-bot: scheduled on-call handoff note: Priya -> Liam at 00:00 UTC. create follow-up for post-mortem if issue persists >1h.

Priya: handing to night oncall Liam for monitoring and customer comms. primary escalation path: Pager -> SRE lead -> Eng Platform. I've updated the incident doc with all actions so far.

Liam: taking over. I'll keep the thread updated with telemetry and CF ticket replies. current plan: maintain alt-route at 50% for 30m, keep bypassed tenants, monitor DD ingestion, escalate if errors >8%.

Priya: thanks team. adding postmortem owners: eng-platform (Alex) + SRE (Liam). Nora, please keep CS updated.

Liam: confirmed — leaving a brief runbook note for the next shift: steps to rollback alt-route: `routectl set-weight alt-route-042 0` then `routectl set-weight main-route 100`.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 created: INC-20230307-042. Handoff recorded.

Nora (CS): status page updated at 23:55 UTC. customers notified via email for those impacted.

Priya: marking this thread for postmortem follow-up. closing operational actions but leaving incident open until CF confirms full POP recovery.

Liam: update @ 00:30 UTC — CF reports propagation complete; EU-West error rates back to baseline (~1%). I'll start cleanup of bypass rules in 15m and coordinate rollback.

Priya: thanks. please attach all tickets to the postmortem. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
